note: Curated log of PUBLIC, market-moving Trump statements. Each entry is sourced and verifiable. This is the same public info anyone can act on legally. The Action can append new entries automatically. NOT financial advice.

events.text: THIS IS A GREAT TIME TO BUY!!! DJT
events.context: Posted the morning of April 9, 2025 (alongside an earlier 'BE COOL! Everything is going to work out well.'). Roughly four hours later Trump announced a 90-day pause on most 'reciprocal' tariffs.
events.market_reaction: S&P 500 surged ~9.5% — its best single day since 2008. Nasdaq +12%. Drew calls from congressional Democrats for an insider-trading probe.

events.text: My NEW Official Trump Meme is HERE! ... $TRUMP
events.context: Trump announced the official $TRUMP memecoin (Solana) days before his inauguration.
events.market_reaction: $TRUMP rocketed to a multi-billion-dollar market cap within 48 hours, then gave back most gains. A $MELANIA token followed and crashed.

events.text: Trump Media & Technology Group begins trading as DJT (Nasdaq) after DWAC SPAC merger.
events.context: Truth Social's parent went public. Trump is the majority shareholder.
events.market_reaction: DJT spiked on debut then stayed extremely volatile and headline-driven; moves heavily on Trump political/legal news.

how_to_read: When Trump signals 'buy' or announces a policy reversal (e.g. pausing tariffs), broad-market ETFs (SPY/QQQ) and Trump-linked names (DJT) tend to spike. The edge is speed + discipline, and remembering the move can reverse on the next post.
